subject: Clarify output title and downstream product restrictions — redline coordination
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@quantumforge.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Reeves <tom.reeves@quantumforge.com>, QuantumForge Legal <legal@quantumforge.com>
Date: 2027-10-01 09:12 PDT
Subject: QuantumForge redlines — MSA + Order Form (initial)

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for taking the call yesterday. Attached are our initial redlines to the MSA and the Order Form. Our legal team flagged two high-level items we want to resolve before procurement signs off:

1) Output ownership / title: We need explicit rights to use model outputs generated by our users inside our products (including derivative functionality).
2) Training/feedback license: We want a narrow right to send anonymized transcripts back to Redwood for service improvement, and a reciprocal commitment that Redwood won’t use our proprietary prompts/data to train general-purpose models for commercial resale.

Please confirm receipt and let us know who on your side will own the legal back-and-forth. We’re hoping to close commercial terms this month.

Attachments: QF_MSA_redline_v1.docx (docx), proposed_order_form_redline.xlsx (xlsx)

Best,
Elena Morales
Sr. Contracts Manager, QuantumForge
From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: Elena Morales <elena@quantumforge.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-10-01 10:03 PDT
Subject: Re: QuantumForge redlines — MSA + Order Form (initial)

Elena — thanks, got the docs. Looping in Kar (legal) and Laura (sales) to align on commercial guardrails. Quick clarifying points before we dive into line edits:

- When you say "explicit rights to use model outputs," can you confirm whether you mean: (A) the right to incorporate outputs into your product features that are sold to your customers (productization), and/or (B) the right to store and analyze outputs for internal analytics and support?
- For the training/feedback license: do you need a perpetual training license, or a limited-time/opt-in telemetry feed?

We typically distinguish between productization (which we treat as a broader IP carveout) and analytics/support usage. If QuantumForge needs productization rights, that may affect pricing/escrow/indemnity. Kar — attaching internal snippet with our standard carveout language for review.

Thanks — I’ll coordinate a 30-min call if that helps.

— Monica Patel
Enterprise Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-10-02 08:46 PDT
Subject: Re: QuantumForge redlines — MSA + Order Form (initial)

Monica / Laura — reviewed the attached redlines. High level: we can probably accept a limited, non-exclusive output license for productization but we need to:

- Carve that grant into the Order Form (scope by product/feature and limited to the customer’s own outputs).
- Require that any model derivatives built using customer outputs be bounded to the customer’s internal use unless a separate commercial agreement is negotiated.
- Add an audit & data segregation clause and a clear definition of "anonymized" so we don’t lose the right to follow up on misuse.

Suggested redline snippet (internal_snippet_training_clause.txt):
"Customer grants Customer-specific output rights for incorporation into Customer products only; Redwood retains right to use aggregated, de-identified telemetry to operate and improve the Service. Redwood will not use Customer-provided content to train models for third-party commercial resale without Customer’s prior written consent."

Commercial implications: productization carveouts should trigger a fee uplift or a negotiated addendum. Ben — can you confirm our commercial flexibility on order-form level?

Karthik Iyer
Head of Legal, Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-10-02 10:21 PDT
Subject: Re: QuantumForge redlines — MSA + Order Form (initial)

Monica / Kar — from a go-to-market view: QuantumForge is enterprise-grade and this Account is in the sales queue for a Q4 launch. We can be flexible on productization for a strategic customer, but we need:

- A clear ordering mechanism (Order Form line item) that states Productization Rights = true and the associated price/commitment (minimum ARR or seat threshold).
- Telemetry/training opt-in: prefer an opt-in checkbox per environment (staging vs prod).
- A timeframe for Redwood to notify customers before changing any telemetry usage — 30 days.

If legal is comfortable with your clause, Kar, I’m happy to propose: Productization Addendum + 12-month pilot pricing (5–10% uplift). Ben, do we have precedent pricing bands for productization?

— Laura
Director, Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Tom Reeves <tom.reeves@quantumforge.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@quantumforge.com>, QuantumForge Legal <legal@quantumforge.com>
Date: 2027-10-04 11:07 PDT
Subject: Re: QuantumForge redlines — MSA + Order Form (initial)

Monica / all — appreciate the quick review. QuantumForge’s position:

- We require the ability to productize outputs (A) for our flagship product — not as a wholesale transfer of rights to third parties. We’re happy to have that scoped to specific features and environments.
- Regarding training: we will agree to “aggregated and de-identified” usage for monitoring, but we request an opt-in mechanism that allows us to provide a separate dataset for model improvement with stronger controls (e.g., data labels, retention limits, and a prohibition on resale).

For transparency, I’ve uploaded our proposed counter-snippet to the Drive and left comments in the .docx: https://drive.redwoodhq.com/drive/folders/QF-MSA-Redlines (see file QuantumForge_counter_snippet.docx). We also need: audit logs of calls and a contact for security reviews.

— Tom Reeves
VP Product, QuantumForge
From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-10-05 15:48 PDT
Subject: Internal: QF redlines — alignment before we send counter

Team — quick check before we respond to QuantumForge:

Summary of asks from customer: productization for a scoped set of features (flagship product), narrow training dataset opt-in with retention controls, audit logs, and a named security reviewer.

Proposed Redwood position to send back:
- Accept productization for scoped features with an Order Form addendum and a commercial uplift (propose 7% uplift for pilot).
- Provide an opt-in training path: Redwood may use aggregated, de-identified telemetry by default for operational improvements; any dataset provided for targeted model tuning will be governed by a Data Use Addendum with retention limits and prohibition on resale.
- Provide call logs and a security contact; coordinate a SOC 2 extract via our Security Operations team (link to request form: https://drive.redwoodhq.com/drive/folders/QF-MSA-Redlines).

Next steps: Kar to draft counter language and the Data Use Addendum; Laura & Ben to confirm pricing bands; I’ll schedule a 30-min sync with QuantumForge (suggest Friday or next Monday).

Attachments: internal_snippet_training_clause.txt

— Monica
Enterprise Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
